notes: The first *his* (t007) belongs to the anarthrous κεφαλῆς as a rule 51/7 helper; the second (t011) to the genitive αὐτοῦ that displaces its article under rule 20.
*covered* is given to κατά under rule 36, which empties a preposition only where English realizes it nowhere; reading *covered* as `added` remains defensible and the unit note records it.
